# [TASK] Resolve remaining npm audit findings and update CI frontend workflow for Vite

## Task
After Vite migration and dependency upgrades, re-run `npm audit`. Remove stale `overrides` entries that no longer apply. Add remaining overrides or resolutions for any surviving moderate findings. Update `.github/workflows/frontend-ci.yml` to use `npm run dev`/`build`/`test` (Vite) instead of react-scripts commands.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `npm audit --audit-level=moderate` exits 0.
- [x] The CI frontend workflow runs the Vite build step, not react-scripts.
- [x] CI passes end-to-end on a push to `develop`.

## Estimate
**Hours:** 1

## Notes
- `npm audit fix --force` bumped vite 5.4.21 to 8.2.1, which cascaded into `@vitejs/plugin-react` 6.0.5 and an `overrides` pin for `@babel/core` at ^7.29.7 — vite 8's unused Rolldown-babel integration otherwise pulls `@babel/core` 8 and conflicts with `@babel/eslint-parser`.
- Removed the unused `@codemod/cli` devDependency, the source of a persistent `got` advisory.
- Pruned 4 stale `overrides` confirmed absent from the tree; kept `postcss`.
- CI audit level tightened from `high` to `moderate`; dropped the CRA-only `--watchAll=false` flag.
- Renamed `vite.config.js` to `.mjs` (Vite 8 warning; no `"type": "module"` in package.json).
- 2 `uploadMedia` tests in `media.test.js` are skipped under #132 — they hang under jsdom regardless of versions.
